page.layout: One column of running text at left; marginal notes in the right margin, beside lines 1 to 3 and the 19th to 20th lines; running head at top; page number at top right; catchword and signature at foot.

main_text.p: respond it: [ut me ad Imperium vos e-ligeretis in vestra situm erat potestate, (O Mili tes) at vero postquam me iam elegistis, quod petitis, in meo est arbitrio, non vestro ; vobis tanquam subditis competit parere, mihi vero quæ faciẹnda sunt cogitare.] Qua responsione audita, mi lites conticuere, eam subdito-rū conditi one esse agnoscentes, ut Prin-cipe supplici citer compellare, nō etiā co-pellere arroganter possint. Valentinianus tamen non ita multo post, in Imperium sibi asciuit Comite, suu fratre Valente, qui Hæresi Arriana infectus, instituit repente velut nubes grandinis plena, (in-quitf Orat.in laudem Basilij. Nazianzenus) & perniciose stri-dens, quæ Ecclesias omnes in quas inci-dit proftrauit. Hanc persequutione, eti-am Basilius Nazianzeni cocetaneus, in Epistola ad Galliæ & Italiæ Episcopos, ita graphice & ad viuum depingit. [Per-sequutio nos apprehendit Fratres, per-sequutionum omnium grauissima. Ne-que qui affliguntur per Martyrij certi-tudinem illatas passiones tolerant, neq; Plebs athletas martyrum loco habet, ac veneratur ; propterea quod Christi-t Epist.70.

page.notes: Left-page edge fragments at the far left are the neighbouring page and were not transcribed. The reference marks "f" and "t" stand as superscript letters in the text; the notes beside them are the marginal notes "Orat.in laudem Basilij." and "Epist.70.". "Nazianzenus" after "(inquit" is set in italic and its first letter is a stylised form, read as N [?]. The word "Nazianzeni" is also italic and reads as printed. The word "cocetaneus" is as printed. The last line "Christi-" breaks at the page foot; "anorum" is the catchword on the same line to the right.
